steel_cv.method: 5-fold cross-validation (shuffled, seed 0) on 312 measured steels, extra-trees, 80 trees

steel_cv_shipped.method: 5-fold cross-validation, out-of-fold predictions on all 312 steels

independent_steel_on_library.note: Library values are typical datasheet values, which depend on heat treatment; this is a small, honest check, not a proof.

library_loo.method: leave-one-out over the 48 library grades; random forest, 80 trees, seed per fold
